name: benchmark-nanodbpedia
description: A compact benchmark built from DBpedia-derived facts intended to evaluate models on knowledge-grounded tasks such as factoid question answering and entity linking using a small/controlled portion of DBpedia. It measures models' ability to map natural language queries to DBpedia entities or triples and return correct, KB-grounded answers. The dataset is useful for lightweight evaluation of KGQA and entity linking approaches.
reputation: A small, niche benchmark with limited adoption useful for rapid prototyping and educational experiments on DBpedia-style tasks.
